speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I need to assess the newborn with the generalized rash, so could you please describe the appearance of the lesions and when they first appeared? Also, has the infant been feeding and acting normally, or are there signs of fever or lethargy?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: Are the lesions primarily vesicular (fluid-filled blisters) or pustular, and have they appeared in crops? I also need to know if the mother had any genital lesions, fever, or flu-like symptoms around the time of delivery.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized erythematous maculopapular rash and pustules. I also have Rash with an erythematous base, Rash over the trunk and extremities, Sparing of the palms and soles.
